# cpanel_email_domain_forwarder (Resource)

Manages the domain-level email forwarder for one cPanel mail domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cpanel_email_domain_forwarder" "legacy" {
  domain      = "example.com"
  destination = "archive.example.net"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination` (String) The external domain that receives mail sent to the source domain.
- `domain` (String) The source mail domain owned by the cPanel account.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cpanel_email_domain_forwarder.legacy example.com
```
